sar.narrative: Customer C04697, holder of card C04697-K1, is the subject of this report due to suspicious unauthorized online transactions totaling $1,499.85. Between 2016-12-10 20:34 and 2016-12-10 20:39, three online purchases were executed from device profile 'Windows | Windows 10 | chrome 66.0 | 1920x1080', consisting of $499.97 on 2016-12-10 20:34 (transaction 3531473), $499.91 on 2016-12-10 20:34 (transaction 3531477), and $499.97 on 2016-12-10 20:39 (transaction 3531493). Every amount sat just below $500 and the purchases were placed minutes apart, a pattern consistent with deliberately staying under an authorization threshold to evade detection. When contacted, the cardholder denied making the transactions and confirmed they still hold the card. This activity is suspicious because it involves 3 online purchases within 4 minutes, each between $400 and $500, totaling $1,499.85 with no apparent lawful purpose. Furthermore, the pattern closely resembles earlier confirmed fraud cases including CC-4124, CC-3841, CC-4086, and CC-3748. In response, the bank has executed automated case creation and analyst escalation, and recommended blocking the card along with filing this report.
